Kept from the intro screens

  • Yellow brush behind one key word ("today?", "your way", "special").
  • Short three-dash sparks next to the words they highlight.
  • A handwritten coral line with a swoosh under it.
  • Birds, boats, waves and palms drawn in code. They become shared parts in the theme package, so every screen uses the same ones.

From the server, never typed in the app

  • Pincode and city, your first name, next delivery slot, categories and their pictures, offers, and the cart count and total.
  • Pictures shown now are stand-ins from your onboarding images. Letters in circles and empty boxes are waiting for the pictures below.
